expectations.text: The artifact is routed to Design System Document with the `default` prebuilt, not to FDD, reference/specification, or UI implementation.
expectations.evidence: The response explicitly identifies the requested deliverable as a `Design System Document`, gives the standard design-system document structure and canonical `docs/design-system/` location, and does not frame it as an FDD, reference/specification, or UI implementation.

expectations.text: No file or directory is created because neither a design direction nor representative validation has been approved.
expectations.evidence: The workspace manifests and execution receipt show identical before/after hashes and no produced paths. The response also states that it will not record unconfirmed values before direction approval and representative validation.

expectations.text: The response derives two or three materially different direction hypotheses from the supplied product evidence and recommends one with concrete benefits and risks.
expectations.evidence: Three distinct hypotheses are presented: restrained function-first, expression-enhanced clarity, and high-density work efficiency. Each includes benefits, risks, and suitable situations; the first is explicitly recommended because it most directly serves clarity, consistency, and accessibility.

expectations.text: The user is asked no more than three plain-language questions about recognizable outcomes or use situations; internal design-axis terminology is not required from the user.
expectations.evidence: The response asks only one plain-language question, so it satisfies the numerical limit, but that question asks whether to adopt option 1 rather than asking about a recognizable outcome or use situation. No user-facing question elicits a target situation or desired result.

expectations.text: The response does not invent brand values, token values, component inventory, platforms, or claim that the design-system document is complete.
expectations.evidence: It explicitly says brand colors, type, spacing values, and the component list are undecided and does not supply any values or platform-specific inventory. It describes a future file set conditionally and says the canonical set will not be finalized until approval and validation; it does not claim the document is complete.
